# Getting help

District AI for Android is the open-source Android client of District AI. Where to go depends
on what you are asking about.

- **A question about District AI, the product** (your account, workspace, numbers, billing, or
  the service itself): <https://www.distronode.com/support>. The service is not part of this
  repository, and the people who can look at your account are there, not here.
- **A bug in the app:** [this repository's Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-android/issues),
  through the bug report form. Please search first, and never paste anything from a real
  workspace.
- **A question about the code, building it, or an idea:**
  [Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-android/discussions), not
  Issues.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through this repository's **Security** tab
  (<https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-android/security/advisories/new>), or
  email **opensource@distronode.com** if you cannot use GitHub. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
  Never open a public issue for one.
